snp2.3:1.1: Hirisutta. Hirin tarantaṃ vijigucchamānaṃ "sakhāham asmi" iti bhāsamānaṃ sayhāni kammāni anādiyantaṃ ‘n' eso manan' ti iti naṃ vijaññā. || ||
snp2.3:2.1: Ananvayaṃ piyaṃ vācaṃ yo mittesu pakubbati, akarontaṃ bhāsamānaṃ parijānanti paṇḍitā. || ||
snp2.3:3.1: Na so mitto yo sadā appamatto bhedāsaṃkī randham evānupassī, yasmiṃ ca seti urasīva putto, sa ve mitto yo parehi abhejjo. || ||
snp2.3:4.1: Pāmujjakaraṇaṃ ṭhānaṃ pasaṃsāvahanaṃ sukhaṃ phalānisaṃso bhāveti vahanto porisaṃ dhuraṃ. || ||
snp2.3:5.1: Pavivekarasam pītvā rasaṃ upasamassa ca niddaro hoti nippāpo dhammapitirasaṃ pivan ti || || HIRISUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ.
